title: bug: PowerShell quoting in both plugins lets curly quotes (and, in JetBrains, a backtick) break out of agent and accounts command lines
description:
Found while planning task-26a3dacde03c4195bfcd3e01e3c59efd (2026-11-02). It is a different class from that row's control characters. Verified with harmless Write-Output payloads on this host's Windows PowerShell 5.1.26100, run through -EncodedCommand:

1. PowerShell's tokenizer reads U+2018, U+2019, U+201A and U+201B as single quotes. psQuote doubles only the ASCII ' in all three places it lives: moe-vscode/src/util/AgentLauncher.ts, moe-vscode/src/providers/AccountsTreeProvider.ts and moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/util/TerminalAgentLauncher.kt. Probe: `Write-Output 'x’; Write-Output PWNED1; ’'` printed x, then PWNED1. VS Code's -EncodedCommand does not help, because the break-out is inside the decoded script. A legitimate project path that holds ’ (for example D:\Bob’s work) also fails to launch: the probe `Write-Output 'D:\Bob’s work'` printed nothing.
2. PowerShell also reads U+201C, U+201D and U+201E as double quotes. JetBrains powerShellLine wraps the inner script in an outer "..." and escapes only the ASCII " and $. Probe: `Write-Output "a”; Write-Output PWNED3; #"` printed a, then PWNED3.
3. JetBrains powerShellLine does not escape the backtick itself. A value holding `" therefore becomes ``" in the typed line: the outer PowerShell reads a literal backtick and then the closing quote. Probe: `Write-Output "-Team 'x``"; Write-Output PWNED2; #'"` printed PWNED2.

Carriers:
- the team name: project.name from the repo-tracked .moe/project.json in VS Code; in JetBrains, the IDE project name, which is the directory name or a repo-tracked .idea/.name;
- the project/workspace path;
- the agent command: under LEGACY, JetBrains takes settings.agentCommand from .moe/project.json unchanged;
- the accounts CLI words.

Fix direction:
- In all three psQuote copies, double every PowerShell single-quote character: ', U+2018, U+2019, U+201A and U+201B. That is the rule of System.Management.Automation.Language.CodeGeneration.EscapeSingleQuotedStringContent.
- In JetBrains, either escape the backtick first and the curly double quotes too in powerShellLine, and keep bashWrapPowerShell's un-escaping consistent with that, or move the PowerShell route to -EncodedCommand as VS Code does.

Depends on task-26a3dace (the same launcher files) and on VSC-15 task-357ed3ae (AccountsTreeProvider.ts).
definitionOfDone: psQuote in moe-vscode/src/util/AgentLauncher.ts, moe-vscode/src/providers/AccountsTreeProvider.ts and moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/util/TerminalAgentLauncher.kt doubles every PowerShell single-quote character (U+0027, U+2018, U+2019, U+201A, U+201B), with a test per file that fails on HEAD.

JetBrains' PowerShell agent and accounts lines, including the bashWrapPowerShell route, keep a value holding a backtick, `", $, or U+201C/U+201D/U+201E inside its own argument, with tests that fail on HEAD.
A project path holding U+2019 (for example D:\Bob’s work) reaches the wrapper intact on both plugins' PowerShell routes, shown by decoding or parsing the built line in a test.
VS Code lint, compile and test pass in a snapshot gate, and JetBrains gradlew.bat test passes under the jetbrains-gradle lease.
